import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths, n_dates, n_assets = perf.shape
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)

    final_idx = int(terms["final_index"])
    notional = float(terms["notional"])

    # basket weights from filing: 40%,25%,17%,11%,7% in order of underlyings
    base_weights = np.array([0.40, 0.25, 0.17, 0.11, 0.07], dtype=float)
    if n_assets == len(base_weights):
        weights = base_weights
    else:
        # fallback to equal weighting if asset count differs
        weights = np.ones(n_assets, dtype=float) / float(n_assets)

    # final performance per underlying: level / initial level
    perf_final = perf[:, final_idx, :]  # (n_paths, n_assets)
    # basket return = sum(w_i * perf_i) - 1  because initial basket =100 * sum w_i *1 =100
    basket_ratio = np.sum(perf_final * weights, axis=1)
    basket_return = basket_ratio - 1.0

    downside_level = float(terms["downside"]["level"])
    gearing = float(terms["downside"]["gearing"])
    buffer_amt = 1.0 - downside_level  # 0.10

    upside = terms.get("upside")
    if upside is not None:
        leverage = float(upside.get("leverage", 1.0))
        cap = upside.get("cap")
    else:
        leverage = 1.0
        cap = None

    # threshold settlement amount from filing: $1,221 per $1,000 face, scaled to notional
    threshold = 1221.0 * (notional / 1000.0)

    payoff = np.empty(n_paths, dtype=float)

    pos_mask = basket_return >= 0
    mid_mask = (basket_return < 0) & (basket_return >= -buffer_amt)
    low_mask = basket_return < -buffer_amt

    if np.any(pos_mask):
        raw = notional * (1.0 + leverage * basket_return[pos_mask])
        if cap is not None:
            cap_amount = notional * (1.0 + float(cap))
            raw = np.minimum(raw, cap_amount)
        payoff[pos_mask] = np.maximum(raw, threshold)

    if np.any(mid_mask):
        payoff[mid_mask] = notional

    if np.any(low_mask):
        val = notional + notional * gearing * (basket_return[low_mask] + buffer_amt)
        # cannot be negative, floor at 0
        val = np.maximum(val, 0.0)
        payoff[low_mask] = val

    # autocall handling (generic): if terms specifies autocall, respect it
    # for this note autocall is None, so payoff goes to final_idx
    autocall = terms.get("autocall")
    if autocall is not None and autocall.get("trigger") is not None:
        # generic autocall not needed for this filing, but keep structure without effect
        pass

    cash[:, final_idx] = payoff
    return cash

import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths, n_dates, n_assets = perf.shape
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)

    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_idx = int(terms["final_index"])

    # Basket weights from filing (40%,25%,17%,11%,7% in order of underlyings)
    filing_weights = np.array([0.40, 0.25, 0.17, 0.11, 0.07], dtype=float)
    if n_assets == filing_weights.size:
        weights = filing_weights
    else:
        weights = np.full(n_assets, 1.0 / float(n_assets), dtype=float)

    # threshold settlement amount $1,221 per $1,000 face, scaled to notional
    threshold_amount = 1221.0 * (notional / 1000.0)

    downside = terms.get("downside", {})
    level = float(downside.get("level", 0.9))
    gearing = float(downside.get("gearing", 1.0))
    buffer_amount = 1.0 - level  # 0.10

    upside = terms.get("upside")
    if upside is not None:
        leverage = float(upside.get("leverage", 1.0) if upside.get("leverage") is not None else 1.0)
        cap = upside.get("cap")
    else:
        leverage = 1.0
        cap = None

    autocall = terms.get("autocall")
    # generic autocall handling (not applicable to this note, kept for completeness)
    if autocall is not None and autocall.get("trigger") is not None and autocall.get("call_amounts") is not None:
        trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
        call_amounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
        # track which paths have been called
        called = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=bool)
        for k in range(n_dates):
            ca = call_amounts[k] if k < len(call_amounts) else None
            if ca is None:
                continue
            # basket ratio on this observation date
            perf_k = perf[:, k, :]
            basket_ratio_k = np.sum(perf_k * weights, axis=1)
            hit = (basket_ratio_k >= trigger - 1e-12) & (~called)
            if np.any(hit):
                cash[hit, k] = float(ca) * (notional / 1000.0) if float(ca) > 50 else float(ca)
                # autocall specification gives cash call amount per note; scale if needed:
                # call_amounts in terms are already per notional; use as is when ~1000
                # correct scaling: if terms notional ==1000, ca is 1000-scale
                # ensure we use ca directly (it is already per note)
                cash[hit, k] = float(ca)
                called[hit] = True
        # if any path was called, do not pay maturity (already handled)
        # for remaining paths, fall through to maturity logic
        # we will compute payoff only for uncalled paths
        uncalled = ~called
        if not np.any(uncalled):
            return cash
        # compute basket return at final for uncalled paths only
        perf_final_all = perf[:, final_idx, :]
        basket_ratio_all = np.sum(perf_final_all * weights, axis=1)
        basket_return_all = basket_ratio_all - 1.0

        payoff = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)
        # masks for uncalled paths
        br = basket_return_all[uncalled]
        pos_m = br >= -1e-12
        mid_m = (br < -1e-12) & (br >= -buffer_amount - 1e-12)
        low_m = br < -buffer_amount - 1e-12

        idx_uncalled = np.where(uncalled)[0]
        # positive
        if np.any(pos_m):
            br_pos = br[pos_m]
            raw = notional * (1.0 + leverage * br_pos)
            if cap is not None:
                cap_val = notional * (1.0 + float(cap))
                raw = np.minimum(raw, cap_val)
            payoff_pos = np.maximum(raw, threshold_amount)
            payoff[idx_uncalled[pos_m]] = payoff_pos
        if np.any(mid_m):
            payoff[idx_uncalled[mid_m]] = notional
        if np.any(low_m):
            br_low = br[low_m]
            val = notional + notional * gearing * (br_low + buffer_amount)
            val = np.maximum(val, 0.0)
            payoff[idx_uncalled[low_m]] = val
        cash[uncalled, final_idx] = payoff[uncalled]
        return cash
    else:
        # no autocall - standard maturity logic
        perf_final = perf[:, final_idx, :]
        basket_ratio = np.sum(perf_final * weights, axis=1)
        basket_return = basket_ratio - 1.0

        payoff = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)

        pos_mask = basket_return >= -1e-12
        mid_mask = (basket_return < -1e-12) & (basket_return >= -buffer_amount - 1e-12)
        low_mask = basket_return < -buffer_amount - 1e-12

        if np.any(pos_mask):
            br_pos = basket_return[pos_mask]
            raw = notional * (1.0 + leverage * br_pos)
            if cap is not None:
                cap_val = notional * (1.0 + float(cap))
                raw = np.minimum(raw, cap_val)
            payoff[pos_mask] = np.maximum(raw, threshold_amount)

        if np.any(mid_mask):
            payoff[mid_mask] = notional

        if np.any(low_mask):
            br_low = basket_return[low_mask]
            val = notional + notional * gearing * (br_low + buffer_amount)
            val = np.maximum(val, 0.0)
            payoff[low_mask] = val

        cash[:, final_idx] = payoff
        return cash

import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    perf = np.asarray(perf, dtype=float)
    n_paths, n_dates, n_assets = perf.shape
    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)

    notional = float(terms["notional"])
    final_idx = int(terms["final_index"])

    # filing weights: EURO STOXX 50 40%, TOPIX 25%, FTSE 100 17%, SMI 11%, ASX 7%
    if n_assets == 5:
        w = np.array([0.40, 0.25, 0.17, 0.11, 0.07], dtype=float)
    else:
        w = np.full(n_assets, 1.0 / float(n_assets), dtype=float)

    # autocall handling (generic, note has autocall=None)
    autocall = terms.get("autocall")
    has_autocall = False
    if autocall is not None:
        trig = autocall.get("trigger")
        cams = autocall.get("call_amounts")
        if trig is not None and cams is not None:
            has_autocall = True

    if has_autocall:
        trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
        call_amounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
        called = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=bool)
        for k in range(n_dates):
            ca = call_amounts[k] if k < len(call_amounts) else None
            if ca is None:
                continue
            perf_k = perf[:, k, :]
            basket_ratio_k = np.sum(perf_k * w, axis=1)
            hit = (basket_ratio_k >= trigger) & (~called)
            if np.any(hit):
                cash[hit, k] = float(ca)
                called[hit] = True
        # maturity for uncalled
        uncalled = ~called
        if np.any(uncalled):
            perf_final = perf[uncalled, final_idx, :]
            basket_ratio = np.sum(perf_final * w, axis=1)
            basket_return = basket_ratio - 1.0

            downside = terms.get("downside", {}) or {}
            level = float(downside.get("level", 0.9))
            gearing = float(downside.get("gearing", 1.1111))
            buffer_amt = 1.0 - level

            upside = terms.get("upside") or {}
            lev = upside.get("leverage")
            if lev is None:
                lev = 1.0
            else:
                lev = float(lev)
            cap = upside.get("cap")

            thresh = 1221.0 * (notional / 1000.0)

            payoff = np.zeros(np.sum(uncalled), dtype=float)
            pos = basket_return >= 0
            mid = (basket_return < 0) & (basket_return >= -buffer_amt - 1e-12)
            low = basket_return < -buffer_amt - 1e-12

            if np.any(pos):
                br = basket_return[pos]
                raw = notional * (1.0 + lev * br)
                if cap is not None:
                    raw = np.minimum(raw, notional * (1.0 + float(cap)))
                payoff[pos] = np.maximum(raw, thresh)
            if np.any(mid):
                payoff[mid] = notional
            if np.any(low):
                br = basket_return[low]
                val = notional + notional * gearing * (br + buffer_amt)
                val = np.maximum(val, 0.0)
                payoff[low] = val

            # place payoff
            idx = np.where(uncalled)[0]
            cash[idx, final_idx] = payoff
        return cash
    else:
        # no autocall
        perf_final = perf[:, final_idx, :]
        basket_ratio = np.sum(perf_final * w, axis=1)
        basket_return = basket_ratio - 1.0

        downside = terms.get("downside", {}) or {}
        level = float(downside.get("level", 0.9))
        gearing = float(downside.get("gearing", 1.1111))
        buffer_amt = 1.0 - level

        upside = terms.get("upside") or {}
        lev = upside.get("leverage")
        if lev is None:
            lev = 1.0
        else:
            lev = float(lev)
        cap = upside.get("cap")

        thresh = 1221.0 * (notional / 1000.0)

        payoff = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=float)

        pos = basket_return >= 0
        mid = (basket_return < 0) & (basket_return >= -buffer_amt - 1e-12)
        low = basket_return < -buffer_amt - 1e-12

        if np.any(pos):
            br = basket_return[pos]
            raw = notional * (1.0 + lev * br)
            if cap is not None:
                raw = np.minimum(raw, notional * (1.0 + float(cap)))
            payoff[pos] = np.maximum(raw, thresh)
        if np.any(mid):
            payoff[mid] = notional
        if np.any(low):
            br = basket_return[low]
            val = notional + notional * gearing * (br + buffer_amt)
            val = np.maximum(val, 0.0)
            payoff[low] = val

        cash[:, final_idx] = payoff
        return cash
